note: Extend the existing query-latency crate and its latency-compare gate, but create no plan goldens or plans/ directory since ADR-0246 withdrew them, relying on latency bands to catch planner cliffs.

Give the new DDL op a typed serde redo payload captured at execution time, store it verbatim on replay with no re-parse and loud decode failure, and push it through the write redo so it counts as applied.

proptest is allowed as a dev-dependency only in cypherlite-storage and relate-executor, so any other engine crate needs its own ADR, and the rules on committed regression files and the rand split apply.
Gate parity on stable scenario identities from ENGINE_PASSING.json rather than aggregate counts, treating the 24 Enterprise identities removed by ADR-0119 as the only exemptions.
Restrict database selection to the three fixed namespaces matched case-insensitively and fail an unknown name with 'Graph not found: <name>' while keeping the DatabaseNotFound kind.

Build the converter and derived graph on the 1.1.0 document shapes via the single parsed value model, apply the loud mapping errors from ADR-0364 section 5 as amended by ADR-0487, and gate on the 1.1.0 schema URI.
